items.name: Masterwork
items.description: RuneScape 3 masterwork equipment, organised item-by-item following RS Wiki craft recipes. Except for 529 apex hides and approximately 115 raw Havenhythe meat/sinew equivalents, all counters start at zero AS UNRECORDED PLACEHOLDERS, not verified bank quantities. Track stages carefully: processed intermediates and raw inputs represent the SAME resources. Additional sets are independent goals. Main index: https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_equipment

children.name: Ranged armour & cape
children.description: Level 110 Crafting, plus completed 'It Should Have Been Called Chinskin'. One shared supply tally prevents hides/sinew being counted repeatedly. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Apex hide +5 unlock
children.description: Unlock chain: 384 apex hides/leather plus 12 apex sinew. Existing 529 hides are accounted for in the single shared counter here. https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hides (achievement uses 384; also used for 120 ranged armour)
children.description: Shared total 384 for apex +5 and 120 for masterwork ranged plates. 529 last confirmed. Do NOT add the 384 and 120 again elsewhere.

children.name: Apex hide cowl +5
children.description: 64 apex leather and 2 apex sinew.  Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hide body +5
children.description: 160 apex leather and 5 apex sinew. Also 1 steel stud and 1 steel bar. Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hide chaps +5
children.description: 96 apex leather and 3 apex sinew. Also 1 steel stud. Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hide vambraces +5
children.description: 32 apex leather and 1 apex sinew. Also 1 steel stud. Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Apex hide boots +5
children.description: 32 apex leather and 1 apex sinew.  Listed individually; leather and sinew are shared materials, not owned five times. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: It Should Have Been Called Chinskin completed
children.description: Craft and upgrade all five apex hide items to +5. Unlocks masterwork ranged crafting; 100 Crafting. https://runescape.wiki/w/It_Should_Have_Been_Called_Chinskin

children.name: Sinew supply (armour + cape + unlock)
children.description: These are transformations of the SAME resources, not additional apex sinew demands. Keep the raw/processed numbers reconciled when updating. https://runescape.wiki/w/Spinning_wheel

children.name: Raw Havenhythe meat / apex sinew equivalent
children.description: ~115 last reported, unverified current balance. Counts usable raw meat OR apex sinew in one combined approximation; do not add it twice. Needs 12 for +5 unlock, 240 for armour, 10 for cape. Process each meat into apex sinew.

children.name: Regular sinew for masterwork sinew
children.description: Need 2 regular sinew per batch of 10 masterwork sinew, 125 batches for 1,250.

children.name: Masterwork sinew crafted
children.description: For 1,200 armour + 50 cape. Every 10 masterwork sinew uses 2 apex sinew +2 regular sinew +10 thread (125 batches). The 250 apex required here plus 12 for unlock equals 262.

children.name: Regular thread for sinew
children.description: 1250 regular thread to craft 125 batches of masterwork sinew. Does not include masterwork thread consumed in making specialist leather.

children.name: Leather crafting (shared full set + cape)
children.description: Finished intermediary totals for the full ranged set AND cape. Raw recipe details appear on each type. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Masterwork monochromatic dragon leather
children.description: 10 body +5 chaps +3 cowl +1 vambraces +1 boots. Each requires 8 black, 8 royal, 8 undead dragon leather, 1 dinosaur leather and 1 masterwork thread.

children.name: Masterwork elasticated leather
children.description: 3 body +2 chaps +2 cowl +1 vambraces +1 boots. Each requires 8 snakeskin, 8 carapace, 8 dagannoth hide, 1 leather and 1 masterwork thread.

children.name: Masterwork chromatic dragon leather
children.description: 1 cowl +1 cape. Each requires 8 green, 8 blue, 8 red dragon leather, 1 hard leather and 1 masterwork thread.

children.name: Masterwork thread for those leathers
children.description: 20 monochromatic +9 elasticated +2 chromatic; ingredient count already represented in leather recipes.

children.name: Ethereal draconic plates (12)
children.description: Chain: 12 glorious +12 Praesulic ranged essence +12 Sirenic essence -> 12 masterwork ranged plates -> 12 draconic plates (120 shards +120 lacquer) -> 12 lined plates (120 apex leather) -> 12 ethereal plates. https://runescape.wiki/w/Lined_draconic_plate_(unimbued)

children.name: Glorious bars for ranged plates
children.description: 12 masterwork ranged plates; one glorious bar each.

children.name: Praesulic essence (ranged)
children.description: Break down Pernix armour at dragonkin anvil for ranged essence.

children.name: Sirenic essence
children.description: Break down Sirenic armour at dragonkin anvil; full undamaged set produces 12.

children.name: Draconic shards
children.description: 12 draconic plates require 120 draconic shards (can be obtained from a draconic visage).

children.name: Lacquer
children.description: Player-owned ports lacquer; used for 12 draconic plates.

children.name: Ethereal draconic plates crafted
children.description: 12 masterwork ranged plates -> draconic plates -> lined with 120 apex leather -> imbued as ethereal draconic plates. The 120 apex leather is INCLUDED in 504-hide shared total, not another 120.

children.name: Armour pieces — individual recipes
children.description: Individual final items; costs are listed in descriptions. Their supplies are pooled ABOVE, not duplicated into separate per-piece counters.

children.name: Masterwork ranged cowl
children.description: 3 monochromatic leather +2 elasticated leather +1 chromatic leather +2 ethereal draconic plates +200 masterwork sinew +1 algarum thread. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Masterwork ranged body
children.description: 10 monochromatic leather +3 elasticated leather +5 ethereal draconic plates +500 masterwork sinew +1 algarum thread. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Masterwork ranged chaps
children.description: 5 monochromatic leather +2 elasticated leather +3 ethereal draconic plates +300 masterwork sinew +1 algarum thread. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Masterwork ranged vambraces
children.description: 1 monochromatic leather +1 elasticated leather +1 ethereal draconic plate +100 masterwork sinew +1 algarum thread. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Masterwork ranged boots
children.description: 1 monochromatic leather +1 elasticated leather +1 ethereal draconic plate +100 masterwork sinew +1 algarum thread. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_ranged_equipment

children.name: Algarum thread for final armour recipes
children.description: 5 for five final pieces. Additional algarum thread may be needed if crafting Sirenic armour before converting it to essence.

children.name: Masterwork ranged cape
children.description: Additional crafted item. Its 1 chromatic leather, 50 sinew, and their raw inputs are INCLUDED above.

children.name: Masterwork white cloth
children.description: 1 white cloth from 50 starbloom cloth and 10 Croesus flakes, if making from scratch.

children.name: Masterwork ranged cape crafted
children.description: Requires 1 masterwork white cloth +1 masterwork chromatic dragon leather +50 masterwork sinew. Chromatic leather and sinew are already included in the ranged shared totals. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_chromatic_dragon_leather

children.name: Full masterwork ranged set custom-fitted (optional)
children.description: Optional follow-up after finishing full set; does not affect creation requirements.

children.name: Melee armour
children.description: Full untrimmed masterwork melee set; 99 Smithing. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_melee_armour

children.name: Unlock: Elder rune +5
children.description: This +5 set is additional to the alloy input bars if crafting every step from ore.

children.name: Elder rune bars for prerequisite set
Elder rune full helm +5
children.description: 64 elder rune bars; included in 384 prerequisite total.

children.name: Elder rune platebody +5
children.description: 160 elder rune bars; included in 384 prerequisite total.

children.name: Elder rune platelegs +5
children.description: 96 elder rune bars; included in 384 prerequisite total.

children.name: Elder rune gauntlets +5
children.description: 32 elder rune bars; included in 384 prerequisite total.

children.name: Elder rune armoured boots +5
children.description: 32 elder rune bars; included in 384 prerequisite total.

children.name: It Should Have Been Called Aetherium completed
children.description: Full elder rune +5 set; required to finish masterwork melee armour.

children.name: Full-set alloy and materials
children.description: 600 of each of 10 metal bar types -> 600 concentrated -> 120 enriched -> 12 immaculate -> 12 glorious -> 12 lined plates; 12 leather and 120 rivets. Stage counters are transformations, NOT additional raw resource costs. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_melee_armour

children.name: Elder rune bars for concentrated alloy
Melee armour pieces
children.description: All quantities draw from the full-set components above. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_melee_armour

children.name: Masterwork melee helm
children.description: 2 glorious/lined plates and 20 rivets; finish at anvil.

children.name: Masterwork melee platebody
children.description: 5 glorious/lined plates and 50 rivets; finish at anvil.

children.name: Masterwork melee platelegs
children.description: 3 glorious/lined plates and 30 rivets; finish at anvil.

children.name: Masterwork melee gloves
children.description: 1 glorious/lined plate and 10 rivets; finish at anvil.

children.name: Masterwork melee boots
children.description: 1 glorious/lined plate and 10 rivets; finish at anvil.

children.name: Trimmed masterwork melee armour
children.description: Requires the five untrimmed pieces listed in Melee armour. The trackers are separate goals, not duplicated inventories.

children.name: Trim components for the set
children.description: Uses the UNTRIMMED masterwork melee items from the sibling grind. One full set of Torva and Malevolent supply the essence for a set of 12 trims. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_melee_armour_trim

children.name: Masterwork melee armour trim
children.description: 12 trims. Each costs 1 elder rune bar +1 malevolent essence +1 Praesulic essence (melee).

children.name: Trim individual pieces
children.description: Counts for trim pieces total 12. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_melee_armour_trim

children.name: Trimmed masterwork melee helm
children.description: Untrimmed masterwork melee helm +2 masterwork trims.

children.name: Trimmed masterwork melee platebody
children.description: Untrimmed masterwork melee platebody +5 trims.

children.name: Trimmed masterwork melee platelegs
children.description: Untrimmed masterwork melee platelegs +3 trims.

children.name: Trimmed masterwork melee gloves
children.description: Untrimmed masterwork melee gloves +1 trim.

children.name: Trimmed masterwork melee boots
children.description: Untrimmed masterwork melee boots +1 trim.

children.name: Custom-fit trimmed masterwork set (optional)
children.description: Optional follow-up; requires full trimmed set.

children.name: Magic armour
children.description: Requires level 110 Crafting and 'It Should Have Been Called Ancestral'. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_magic_equipment

children.name: Unlock: Starbloom +5
children.description: 384 cloth / 768 thread / 768 flower (a single production chain, not additive material demands). https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_magic_equipment

children.name: Starbloom thread for +5 set
children.description: 768 starbloom threads are made from 768 starbloom flowers; they become 384 starbloom cloth.

children.name: Starbloom hat +5
children.description: 64 starbloom cloth, 128 starbloom thread/flowers from scratch. Counts included in shared unlock pool.

children.name: Starbloom robe top +5
children.description: 160 starbloom cloth, 320 starbloom thread/flowers from scratch. Counts included in shared unlock pool.

children.name: Starbloom robe bottom +5
children.description: 96 starbloom cloth, 192 starbloom thread/flowers from scratch. Counts included in shared unlock pool.

children.name: Starbloom gloves +5
children.description: 32 starbloom cloth, 64 starbloom thread/flowers from scratch. Counts included in shared unlock pool.

children.name: Starbloom boots +5
children.description: 32 starbloom cloth, 64 starbloom thread/flowers from scratch. Counts included in shared unlock pool.

children.name: It Should Have Been Called Ancestral completed
children.description: Full starbloom +5 set; prerequisite to masterwork magic armour.

children.name: Magic set crafting components
children.description: These are shared full-set requirements and intermediate crafting stages; don't count the same ingredient twice. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_magic_equipment

children.name: Masterwork white cloth
children.description: Requires 1,000 starbloom cloth and 200 Croesus flakes to produce 20 white cloth.

children.name: Masterwork blue cloth
children.description: Requires 36 strips of cloth, 36 each imphide/spider silk/batwing/mystic cloth, 18 bark and 18 fine cloth.

children.name: Masterwork green cloth
children.description: Requires 10 starbloom cloth and 1,000 each fungal, grifolic and ganodermic flakes.

children.name: Masterwork thread
children.description: 1,200 thread plus 120 each of Fallfaced, Springsheared, Summerdown, Winterwold wool to craft 1,200 masterwork thread.

children.name: Ethereal pearlescent plates
children.description: For 12: 12 tectonic essence, 12 praesulic essence magic, 60 pearls, 120 platinum bars, 12 undead dragon leather and 12 brown dyes.

children.name: Magic armour pieces
children.description: Per-item recipes: https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_magic_equipment

children.name: Masterwork magic hat
children.description: 3 masterwork white cloth +2 blue +1 green +2 ethereal pearlescent plates +200 masterwork thread +1 stone of binding.

children.name: Masterwork magic robe top
children.description: 10 white cloth +3 blue +5 ethereal pearlescent plates +500 masterwork thread +1 stone of binding.

children.name: Masterwork magic robe bottom
children.description: 5 white cloth +2 blue +3 ethereal pearlescent plates +300 masterwork thread +1 stone of binding.

children.name: Masterwork magic gloves
children.description: 1 white cloth +1 blue +1 ethereal pearlescent plate +100 masterwork thread +1 stone of binding.

children.name: Masterwork magic boots
children.description: 1 white cloth +1 blue +1 ethereal pearlescent plate +100 masterwork thread +1 stone of binding.

children.name: Masterwork bow
children.description: Masterwork bow item recipe. The progress bar represents its requirements: Fletch Quest, an unstrung masterwork bow (limbs, grooves, and grip), and waxed masterwork string. Each nested branch breaks down into the parts needed; no separate duplicate final-item counters. Assembly steps are described in the wiki. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_bow

children.name: Fletch Quest
children.description: Requires upgraded eternal magic shortbow and primal crossbows to Mk. 5; prerequisite. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_bow

children.name: Unstrung masterwork bow
children.description: Only uncrafted components expand to show their required ingredient items; completed parts are terminal counters.

children.name: Masterwork bow limbs
children.description: Finished and owned. Upstream wood, glorious bars, limb supports and rivets are already consumed; no need to track them twice.

children.name: Masterwork bowstring grooves
children.description: Finished and owned; earlier glorious/gold bars already consumed.

children.name: Masterwork bow grip
children.description: Wrapped grip + upper decorated support + lower decorated support. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_bow

children.name: Wrapped masterwork bow grip
children.description: Finished and owned; its raw glorious/gold/leather/dye supplies were already consumed.

children.name: Upper decorated masterwork bow grip support
children.description: Combines one plain support with one faceted noxious sapphire. Finished decorated support not yet confirmed.

children.name: Masterwork bow grip support
children.description: One of the two already-owned plain supports.

children.name: Faceted noxious sapphire
children.description: 2 noxious essence + 1 sapphire → unimbued → imbued → faceted. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_bow

children.name: Noxious essence
children.description: For noxious sapphire (unimbued); verify current inventory before updating.

children.name: Sapphire
children.description: One sapphire for this specific gem; second sapphire needed in the other support branch.

children.name: Lower decorated masterwork bow grip support
children.description: Combines one plain support with one faceted ascended sapphire. Finished decorated support not yet confirmed.

children.name: Masterwork bow grip support
children.description: The other already-owned plain support.

children.name: Faceted ascended sapphire
children.description: 2 ascended essence + 1 sapphire → unimbued → imbued → faceted. Source: https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_bow

children.name: Ascended essence
children.description: For ascended sapphire (unimbued); verify current inventory before updating.

children.name: Sapphire
children.description: One sapphire for this specific gem; second sapphire needed in the other support branch.

children.name: Waxed masterwork string
children.description: One bucket of refined wax + one magic string. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_bow

children.name: Bucket of refined wax
children.description: Note: RS Wiki 16 Mar 2026 update replaced bucket of vis wax with refined wax.

children.name: Bucket of wax
children.description: Obtained from a beehive using insect repellent; unconfirmed.

children.name: Bucket of water
children.description: To refine the wax; unconfirmed.

children.name: Magic string
children.description: From magic roots; inventory unconfirmed.

children.name: Masterwork staff
children.description: Item-first recipe: Masterwork staff = handle + focus, with Crafting to Your Own Rune prerequisite. Nested component branches contain the actual required items. Zero means you reported no progress on this staff yet. Wiki: https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_staff

children.name: Crafting to Your Own Rune
children.description: Unlock by making and upgrading the required eternal magic weaponry to +5. Needed before creating the staff. https://runescape.wiki/w/Crafting_to_Your_Own_Rune

children.name: Masterwork staff handle
children.description: Imbue one grounded base and 2 wrapped grips at a Runecrafting altar. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_staff

children.name: Grounded masterwork staff base
children.description: Forge two gold bars + one volatile runic brick + four crystalline essence. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_staff

children.name: Gold bars
children.description: Two gold bars for the grounded base; two additional gold bars go into the focus bracket.

children.name: Volatile runic brick
children.description: One of three bricks for the staff; each requires 1,000 pure essence fragments and 1,000 of each of 15 runes, processed at a Runecrafting altar. https://runescape.wiki/w/Masterwork_staff

children.name: Crystalline essence (4)
children.description: Four essence from two fully repaired attuned crystal wands/orbs. Alternative attuned crystal staffs require more harmonic dust.

children.name: Attuned crystal wands / orbs (2)
children.description: Produce two attuned magic weapons, then break them down at a dragonkin anvil for 4 crystalline essence.

children.name: Attuned crystal weapon seeds
children.description: Use 2 attuned crystal weapon seeds at a singing bowl; source for the 2 attuned wands/orbs.

children.name: Harmonic dust
children.description: Use 2,000 harmonic dust for 2 attuned wands/orbs. Crystal staffs instead require 4,000.

children.name: Wrapped masterwork staff grips (2)
children.description: Two grips; each requires a chain starting from 20 eternal magic logs and one dyed undead dragon leather. Both grips together use 40 logs, 2 leather, 2 dye.

children.name: Eternal magic logs
children.description: 40 eternal magic logs → 20 inert eternal magic staves → 2 unwrapped grips.

children.name: Undead dragon leather
children.description: Dye 2 undead dragon leather brown, then wrap the 2 unwrapped grips.

children.name: Brown dye
children.description: One brown dye per piece of undead dragon leather.

children.name: Masterwork staff focus
children.description: House the unhoused focus, then combine the housed focus with the focus bracket at a Runecrafting altar.

children.description: Four melodic essence and one volatile runic brick make the conduit; imbue into an imbued masterwork runic conduit.
